headline: Indian stock market crashes as Sensex slumps 1,000 points amid profit booking and weak global cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit-taking by investors following a four-week market rally
Sharp drag in financial, banking, and metal sector stocks
Weak global market cues and global sell-off pressures
Spike in market volatility with India VIX jumping nearly 8%
whatHappening: Sensex plummeted over 1,000 points intraday after reversing early opening gains
Nifty dropped heavily, slipping below the 25,500 mark with Nifty Bank dragging
Dalmia Bharat board approved a ₹700 crore share buyback via the open market route
Supreme Court refused the Income Tax Department's plea to reopen a decades-old Reliance merger tax case
summary:
Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty crashed today, reversing early gains due to heavy profit-taking and weak global cues.
Financials, banks, and metal stocks were among the biggest laggards as market volatility spiked significantly.
In corporate developments, Dalmia Bharat approved a ₹700 crore buyback, while Reliance secured tax relief from the Supreme Court.
